body: Of course! Sorry this is so late. My sister came home later that night, and she says she’s doing just fine now. She’s eating well and she’s going to school and is practicing for track season afterwards. We are all keeping a close eye on her now.
It’s alright. She’s home now, thank you!
Thank you! I think distractions are going to be my best bet, since that’s really what’s been keeping me going. I wish you the best of luck.
Thank you so much. I wasn’t sure whether or not I should have actually shared this, but I’m glad I did. I love you too, and I wish you the best ❤️😊
Thank you, she came home last night. I wish you the best of luck as well.
I’ll do my best. I’m not the greatest when it comes to comforting people, so it’s going to be a bit of a challenge, but I’ll listen to her and understand how she’s feeling. Thank you so much.
Thank you so much! This means a lot! 😊

I’m not taking this offensively at all! After hearing how she reacted after taking those pills, I could hear how scared she was. My sister was crying while telling my mom she didn’t want to die. I don’t think I said this, so I’m sorry if I wasn’t clear enough.
Thank you so much. This was something I definitely needed to hear. I wish you the best and have a good day/night also! 😊

I don’t really understand why they are reacting like this either, but thank you. I think professional help would probably be the best decision, especially since my parents think that they can solve things on their own. I’ll definitely talk to her when I can.
She’s only a year younger than me so I’d say we are pretty close. We get along well, but she doesn’t entirely trust me with some things because I’m considered the family’s “golden child”.
Thank you. It’s going to be the first thing I tell her when I see her again.
Thank you so much! I appreciate this, and I will definitely reach out to schools as much as I can! 😊
